name: Row Your Boat
description: Row on the beat down a dream of a river. Fastest boat wins.

badges.name: Perfect Verse
badges.description: Sixteen perfect strokes in a row.

badges.name: Gently Down the Stream
badges.description: Finish a stream without a single bump.

badges.name: Photo Finish
badges.description: Win a race by under a tenth of a second.

badges.name: Choir
badges.description: Finish a race with three or more other people.

badges.name: Dreamer
badges.description: Finish all eight streams of The Dream.

badges.name: Life Is But a Dream
badges.description: Earn all 24 stars of The Dream.

badges.name: Merrily!
badges.description: Row all twelve notes of a merrily bar.

badges.name: Bouquet
badges.description: Take all five moonblooms of a line.

badges.name: Close Shave
badges.description: Slip past a rock with a hand's width to spare.

controls.action: Left oar (left half of the screen)
Right oar (right half of the screen)
